The '''sonic screecher''' was part of a combination used in [[smoke screamer]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] utilized by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Puggles Trodd/Legends|Puggles Trodd]]. When the sonic screecher was combined with a [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke bomb]], the detonation caused caused an ear-piercing wail and clouds of think, dark smoke .<ref name="Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>
